messages:
Maya Patel: quick sync — planning API auth/tenant surface for the next rollout. primary asks: per-project api keys, key rotation UX, and how function-calling/structured outputs affect token auditing. thoughts?
Chris Nguyen: +1, we need explicit mapping: key -> org_id -> project_id. otherwise billing/quotas get messy.
Jamal Ortiz: agree. also need to decide whether embeddings + rerank use the same key scoping as chat. my vote: same scoping but separate quota buckets.
Alex Rivera: can we keep legacy keys working as org-scoped for migration? customers will freak if rotation breaks things. propose: default legacy behavior for 6 months, but warn on calls.
Maya Patel: good call. migration window + telemetry. what about rotation API shape? `POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate` returns `new_key`, `expires_at`? or do we force rotate to disabled old key?
Chris Nguyen: prefer: rotation returns new key and soft-deprecates old (old still works for X days). add `force_rotate=true` if you want immediate revoke.
Jamal Ortiz: need audit trail in logs: who rotated, IP, timestamp. tie to KMS metadata if in Private deployments.
emily.devbot: FYI: previous incident #INC-2024-09 shows surprise breakage when keys were hot-rotated without migration window. recommend 72h soft window by default.
Alex Rivera: UX: SDKs should expose `Key.rotate()` sync helper and background refresh so customers can rotate without downtime. doc snippet: ````js
await client.keys.rotate(keyId, {gracePeriod: 72*3600})
````
Maya Patel: routing implications: if key->project maps to model routing rules (e.g., premium models for some projects), rotation must preserve those bindings immediately. cannot have eventual consistency >30s.
Chris Nguyen: backend can publish a lightweight config version per key to etcd; rotation should bump version and invalidate caches. need rollout criteria: 99th perc cache invalidation < 2s in prod.
Jamal Ortiz: for function-calls and structured output we also need token-level attribution for billing and safety scans. that ties into per-key token counters and per-function usage.
Alex Rivera: launch criteria checklist draft:
- API: `POST /v1/keys`, `GET /v1/keys/:id`, `POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate`, `DELETE /v1/keys/:id` (soft delete + hard after grace)
- SDK support for rotate/refresh
- Migration plan + 6mo legacy mode with metrics and warnings
- Audit logs + KMS hooks for private
- Token accounting per key & per-project for chat, embeddings, rerank, function-calls
- Canary: 1% orgs for 48h, 10% for 7d, then full
Maya Patel: love it. can we add a short note on rate-limit behavior: when project quotas hit, should we fail fast for keys or fallback to lower-tier model variants? devs expect both options.
Chris Nguyen: make it policy-configurable per project: `on_quota_exhaustion: [fail, fallback, queue]` default `fail`. include in console and API.
Jamal Ortiz: security note: rotation tokens must be returned only once and stored hashed server-side. also limit rotate frequency to prevent token churn attacks.
emily.devbot: checklist reminder: add e2e test that rotates keys during heavy traffic + verifies no request attribution loss.
Alex Rivera: i'll draft the product spec PR with the above and include sample curl flows and migration guide. target: spec ready EOW, engineering scope estimate next week.
Maya Patel: thanks — ping me in PR for prioritization. I'll slot this as P1 for next two-week planning if engineering estimate <= 3 sprint-weeks. :thumbsup:
Chris Nguyen: noted. adding to roadmap board now.
Jamal Ortiz: also ping infra for etcd perf tests.
emily.devbot: deploy-bot: created checklist issue PROD-keys-rotation-2025-11 (link: https://redwood.internal/issue/PROD-keys-rotation-2025-11)
